text: Business Administration program comes under the Business Administration department of college of economics and management. Relying on the two disciplines of "management" and "economics", we foster and provide the senior practical management talents for the national defender agencies, local enterprises, financial organizations who will effectively contribute to production and operation, human resources and financial management. The college of economics and management possesses a center laboratory with usable area of 1033m2, including ERP Lab, E-commerce and Logistics Lab, Financial Lab, simulation Lab for Enterprise business decision, Accounting simulation Lab, and experimental innovation Room , which provide an open platform for the practicing teaching of our related courses. For the effective implementation of talent training mode of combination of the theoretical and practical teaching, we provide following core courses: Management, Economics, Management Information Systems, Statistics, Accounting, Financial Management, Marketing, Economic law, Human Resource Management, Enterprises strategic Management. In fostering process we highlight the training of research innovation and professional skills, emphasizing the training of practical capacity.
